snippet.title: How Asian Parents went to School ? Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Reveal trailer for "How Asian Parents went to school ?" An online co-op adventure game about reaching school as an Asian parent with up to 4 players. Tablo Escobar's "Emotional damage" is waiting for you...

Wishlist now! ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154510/How_Asian_Parents_went_to_School/
